story.title: Routes through two collections: performance, public life and documentary context
story.introduction: A TJLabs working proposal for a metadata-led route through two existing public catalogue pages. It begins with a family-photograph booklet link, explores performance objects and interview labels, follows a sequence of sporting awards, and compares campaign communication objects. Each link returns to its institution's original record. The sequence is an editorial proposal for discussion; it contains no reproduced collection media and does not represent institutional approval.
story.note: Prepared by the TJLabs assistant from the two complete retained ArchiveBlack catalogue pages. All 44 original labels, links and source positions remain available. 'Include' means selected for this internal metadata proposal; all rights statuses remain unknown. Relationship labels distinguish exact source observations from proposed themes. Underlying object records and media have not supplied additional verified facts in this edition. Entries marked needs-info have concrete clarification questions and remain in the complete review, outside the selected story.
